/* * isry.couns.stats.consttprfmnc.mapper.ConPerformanceStatsMapper.selectCnsltntPerformanceStatsList : 부서코드 값에 따른 상담자별 실적 조회 */ WITH USER1 AS ( SELECT T2.USER_ID AS USER_ID /* 사용자 아이디 */ , T1.ENFSN_NO AS ENFSN_NO /* 종사자번호 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM /* 상담원 이름 */ , T1.OGDP_DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD /* 소속 부서 코드 */ FROM SCA100 T1 , SAA200 T2 WHERE 1=1 AND T2.ENFSN_NO = T1.ENFSN_NO
AND T1.OGDP_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD}
AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T2.JOIN_APRV_YN = 'Y' ) SELECT CM.USER_ID, CM.FLNM, NVL(AA.CNT24,0) AS CNT24, /* 채팅수 */ NVL(EE.CNT1,0) AS CNT1, /* 게시판할당량 */ NVL(DD.CNT05,0) AS CNT05, /* 비밀 */ NVL(DD.CNT01,0) AS CNT01, /* 솔로봇 */ NVL(BB.CNT31,0) + NVL(BB.CNT18,0) + NVL(DD.CNT36,0) AS CNT99, /* 기타상담(31네이버,18오픈채팅,36구글) */ NVL(DD.CNT05,0) + NVL(DD.CNT01,0) + NVL(BB.CNT31,0) + NVL(BB.CNT18,0) + NVL(DD.CNT36,0) AS TCNT1, /* 합계1 */ NVL(EE.CNT2,0) AS CNT2, /* 댓글상담할당량 */ NVL(CC.CNT08,0) AS CNT08, /* 댓글상담실 */ NVL(CC.CNT02,0) AS CNT02, /* 솔로봇채팅 */ NVL(CC.CNT03,0) AS CNT03, /* 이음e */ NVL(CC.CNT04,0) AS CNT04, /* 웹심리검사 */ NVL(CC.CNT14,0) AS CNT14, /* 고민해결백과 */ NVL(CC.CNT15,0) AS CNT15, /* 자녀맘터치법 */ NVL(CC.CNT08,0) + NVL(CC.CNT02,0) + NVL(CC.CNT03,0) + NVL(CC.CNT04,0) + NVL(CC.CNT14,0) + NVL(CC.CNT15,0) AS TCNT2, /* 합계2 */ NVL(BB.CNT351,0) AS CNT351, /* SNS아웃리치(메신저) */ NVL(BB.CNT357,0) AS CNT357, /* SNS아웃리치(댓글) */ NVL(BB.CNT356,0) AS CNT356, /* SNS아웃리치(홍보) */ NVL(DD.CNT12,0) AS CNT12, /* 사이버상담후기 */ NVL(FF.CNT91,0) AS CNT91, /* 연계상담 */ NVL(GG.CNT92,0) AS CNT92, /* 사후관리 */ NVL(HH.CNT93,0) AS CNT93 /* 연계의뢰 */ FROM USER1 CM, ( SELECT A.CNSLTNT_ID ID, /* 담원아이디 */ COUNT(*) CNT24 /* 채팅수 */ FROM AYB200 A , USER1 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND A.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND A.CNSLTNT_ID = B.USER_ID GROUP BY A.CNSLTNT_ID ) AA, ( SELECT FRST_RGTR_ID ID, /* 상담원아이디 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT31, /* 네이버 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '18' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT18, /* 오픈채팅 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '35' AND OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT351, /* SNS아웃리치(메신저) */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '35' AND OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD = '7' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT357, /* SNS아웃리치(댓글) */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '35' AND OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD = '6' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT356 /* SNS아웃리치(홍보) */
FROM AYE100 A , USER1 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND A.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND A.FRST_RGTR_ID = B.USER_ID GROUP BY A.FRST_RGTR_ID ) BB, ( SELECT FRST_RGTR_ID ID, /* 담원아이디 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT08, /* 글상담실 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT02, /* 로봇채팅 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT03, /* 음e */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT04, /* 심리검사 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT14, /* 민해결백과 */ SUM(CASE WHEN BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT15 /* 자녀맘터치법 */ FROM AYE110 A , USER1 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND A.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND A.FRST_RGTR_ID = B.USER_ID GROUP BY A.FRST_RGTR_ID ) CC, ( SELECT A.FRST_RGTR_ID ID, /* 상담원아이디 */ SUM(CASE WHEN A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '05' THEN CEIL(NVL(LENGTH(BBSCTT_CN),0)/1000) ELSE 0 END) CNT05, /* 비밀 */ SUM(CASE WHEN A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT01, /* 솔로봇 */ SUM(CASE WHEN A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT12, /* 사이버상담후기 */ SUM(CASE WHEN A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '36' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT36 /* 구글 */ FROM AYE120 A , USER1 B , AYE100 C WHERE 1=1 AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = C.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = C.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND A.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND A.FRST_RGTR_ID = B.USER_ID GROUP BY A.FRST_RGTR_ID ) DD, ( SELECT B.USER_ID ID, /* 상담원아이디 */ SUM(A.NTABRD_ASGN_NOCS) CNT1, /* 게시판할당량 */ SUM(A.CMNT_ASGN_NOCS) CNT2 /* 댓글할당량 */ FROM AYC170 A , USER1 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = B.DEPT_CD
AND A.RLVT_YM >= SUBSTR(#{START_DT}, 0, 6) AND A.RLVT_YM <= SUBSTR(#{END_DT}, 0, 6)
AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY B.USER_ID ) EE, ( SELECT FRST_RGTR_ID ID, /* 상담원아이디 */ COUNT(*) CNT91 /* 연계상담 */ FROM AYA120 A , USER1 B WHERE 1=1
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') + (INTERVAL '1' YEAR)
AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND FRST_RGTR_ID = B.USER_ID GROUP BY A.FRST_RGTR_ID ) FF, ( SELECT FRST_RGTR_ID ID, /* 상담원아이디 */ COUNT(*) CNT92 /* 사후관리 */ FROM AYA190 A , USER1 B WHERE 1=1
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND FRST_RGTR_ID = B.USER_ID GROUP BY A.FRST_RGTR_ID ) GG, ( SELECT A.CLINT_NO NO, /* 종사자번호 */ COUNT(*) CNT93 /* 연계의뢰 */ FROM SEB400 A , USER1 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.CLINT_NO = B.ENFSN_NO /* 종사자번호 */
AND A.RQST_YMD >= TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.RQST_YMD <= TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
GROUP BY A.CLINT_NO ) HH WHERE CM.USER_ID = AA.ID(+) AND CM.USER_ID = BB.ID(+) AND CM.USER_ID = CC.ID(+) AND CM.USER_ID = DD.ID(+) AND CM.USER_ID = EE.ID(+) AND CM.USER_ID = FF.ID(+) AND CM.USER_ID = GG.ID(+) AND CM.ENFSN_NO = HH.NO(+)

WITH AA20 AS( /*소속기관별상담사*/ SELECT T2.USER_ID AS USER_ID , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM , T1.OGDP_DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD FROM ( SELECT * FROM SCA100 WHERE (RETIRE_YMD IS NULL OR RETIRE_YMD > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) AND OGDP_DEPT_CD IN ('324') AND DEL_YN = 'N' ) T1 , ( SELECT * FROM SAA200 WHERE JOIN_APRV_YN = 'Y' AND USER_CNTN_INTRCP_YN = 'N' AND (USE_END_YMD IS NULL OR USE_END_YMD > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) ) T2 WHERE 1=1 AND T2.ENFSN_NO = T1.ENFSN_NO ) ,DD20 AS( SELECT AA20.USER_ID A..............S USER_ID , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYB200.CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('08','02','07','05','06') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CHTT /*채팅*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYE120.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SEC /*나의 게시판상담실적:비밀*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYE120.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SOLBOARD /*나의 게시판상담실적:솔로봇*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYE100.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('31','18') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ETC1 /*나의 게시판상담실적:기타상담_네이버,오픈채팅*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYE110.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '36' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ETC2 /*나의 게시판상담실적:기타상담_구글*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYE110.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS BORDCOUN /*나의 댓글상담실적:댓글*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYE110.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SOLREPLE /*나의 댓글상담실적:솔로봇*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYE110.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS WEB /*나의 댓글상담실적:웹심리*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYE110.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS EUM /*나의 댓글상담실적:이음e*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYE110.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '15' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS PARENT /*나의 댓글상담실적:자녀맘*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYE110.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS GOMIN /*나의 댓글상담실적:고민해결백과*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYE100.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '35' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS OUTRC /*아웃리치*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYE110.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '12' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CYBER /*사이버상담후기*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYA120.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('24','05','35','18','02','31') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DSCSN /*연계상담*/ , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AYA190.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('24','05','35','18','02','31') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS AFTFCT /*사후관리*/ , COUNT(SEB400.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO) AS LINK /*연계의뢰*/ FROM AA20 LEFT OUTER JOIN AYE100 /*사이버상담게시글*/ ON AA20.USER_ID = AYE100.FRST_RGTR_ID AND AYE100.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 AND AYE100.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('31','18','35') LEFT OUTER JOIN AYE110 /*사이버상담댓글 */ ON AA20.USER_ID = AYE110.FRST_RGTR_ID AND AYE110.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 AND AYE110.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('36','08','02','12') LEFT OUTER JOIN AYE120 /*사이버상담답글 */ ON AA20.USER_ID = AYE120.FRST_RGTR_ID AND AYE120.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 AND AYE120.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('05','01') LEFT OUTER JOIN AYB200 /*채팅이력 */ ON AA20.USER_ID = AYB200.FRST_RGTR_ID AND AYB200.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 AND AYB200.CHTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('08','02','07','05','06') LEFT OUTER JOIN AYA120 /*위기상담_개인 */ ON AA20.USER_ID = AYA120.FRST_RGTR_ID AND AYA120.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 AND AYA120.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('24','05','35','18','02','31') LEFT OUTER JOIN AYA190 /*사후관리 */ ON AA20.USER_ID = AYA190.FRST_RGTR_ID AND AYA190.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 AND AYA190.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('24','05','35','18','02','31') LEFT OUTER JOIN SEB400 /*서비스제공의뢰 */ ON AA20.USER_ID = SEB400.FRST_RGTR_ID AND SEB400.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 GROUP BY USER_ID ) SELECT AA20.FLNM AS MEM_NAME /*상담사*/ , NVL(CHTT,0) AS CHTT /*채팅 */ , NVL(AYC170.NTABRD_ASGN_NOCS,0) AS BG_01 /*게시판상담할당량 */ , SEC AS SEC /*나의 게시판상담실적:비밀*/ , SOLBOARD AS SOLBOARD /*나의 게시판상담실적:솔로봇*/ , ETC1+ETC2 AS ETC /*나의 게시판상담실적:기타상담*/ , SEC + SOLBOARD + ETC1 + ETC2 AS BORD_TOT_CNT /*나의 게시판상담실적 합*/ , NVL(AYC170.CMNT_ASGN_NOCS,0) AS CMNT_ASGN_NOCS /*댓글상담할당량 */ , BORDCOUN AS BORDCOUN /*나의 댓글상담실적:댓글*/ , SOLREPLE AS SOLREPLE /*솔로봇*/ , WEB AS WEB /*웹심리*/ , EUM AS EUM /*이음e*/ , PARENT AS PARENT /*자녀맘*/ , GOMIN AS GOMIN /*고민해결백과*/ , BORDCOUN + SOLREPLE + WEB + EUM + PARENT + GOMIN AS REP_TOT_CNT /*나의댓글상담실적 합*/ , OUTRC AS OUTRC /*아웃리치*/ , CYBER AS CYBER /*사이버상담후기*/ , DSCSN AS DSCSN /*연계상담*/ , AFTFCT AS AFTFCT /*사후관리*/ , LINK AS LINK /*연계의뢰*/ FROM AYC170 /*월별상담자게시판댓글할당*/ , AA20 LEFT OUTER JOIN DD20 ON AA20.USER_ID = DD20.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN AYB200 /*채팅이력*/ ON AA20.USER_ID = AYB200.CNSLTNT_ID AND AYB200.CHTT_BGNG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 WHERE AYC170.RLVT_YM = SUBSTR(#{startDate},1,6) /*FROMYM*/ AND AYC170.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AYC170.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = AA20.DEPT_CD GROUP BY AA20.FLNM , CHTT , NVL(AYC170.NTABRD_ASGN_NOCS,0) , SEC , SOLBOARD , ETC1+ETC2 , SEC + SOLBOARD + ETC1 + ETC2 , NVL(AYC170.CMNT_ASGN_NOCS,0) , BORDCOUN , SOLREPLE , WEB , EUM , PARENT , GOMIN , BORDCOUN + SOLREPLE + WEB + EUM + PARENT + GOMIN , OUTRC , CYBER , DSCSN , AFTFCT , LINK
